status: 'draft'

---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase A (Architecture Vision)**: This document is the authoritative Phase A output for the {security_capability_name} capability. It establishes *why* this architecture exists and *what it must achieve*. It authorizes and sponsors the ABB hierarchy beneath it. All Component ABBs in this domain reference this document.
>
> **Reading order**: Vision (this document) → Capability Descriptions → Capability Map → Composite ABB → ABB Alignment Matrix → Component ABBs → Reference Architecture Documents.

page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-vision-alignment-template.md#normative-language-convention]

## Normative Language Convention

This document and all documents in the {security_capability_name} guidance hierarchy use normative language per RFC 2119:

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **SHALL** | Mandatory — absolute obligation |
| **SHALL NOT** | Mandatory prohibition |
| **SHOULD** | Strongly recommended — deviation requires documented justification |
| **SHOULD NOT** | Strongly discouraged — deviation requires documented justification |
| **MAY** | Optional — permitted but not required |

> **Exception and Waiver Process**: Teams that cannot meet a SHALL requirement must submit a risk acceptance or waiver request through the established enterprise governance process. Waivers require documented risk justification and approval from appropriate security leadership or designated delegate. Temporary waivers must include a remediation timeline.
